mapper.select: select document_id, enterprise_id, title, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, doc_type, status, chunk_count, error_msg, upload_by, create_time, update_time from t_kb_document where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and del_flag = '0' order by document_id desc

select document_id, enterprise_id, title, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, doc_type, status, chunk_count, error_msg, upload_by, create_time, update_time from t_kb_document where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and document_id = #{documentId} and del_flag = '0'

select document_id, enterprise_id, title, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, doc_type, status, chunk_count, error_msg, upload_by, create_time, update_time from t_kb_document where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and file_path = #{filePath} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_kb_document (enterprise_id, title, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, doc_type, status, chunk_count, upload_by, create_time) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{title}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{docType}, #{status}, #{chunkCount}, #{uploadBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update t_kb_document set status = #{status}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, update_time = sysdate() where document_id = #{documentId}
